o.text:
Inherited from Old Anatolian Turkish آچمق (açmaq), from Proto-Turkic *ač- (“to open”)
Cognate with
Gagauz açmaa, Turkish açmak and Turkmen açmak.
From Middle Mongol ᠵᠢᠳᠠ (ǰida), compare modern Mongolian жад (žad).

Inherited from Old Anatolian Turkish صاواشمق. Ultimately derived from Proto-Turkic *sāb (“word, speech”).
Its original meaning is “verbal dispute”.
From bazar + -kom, possibly analogically from sinifkom.
